hints.title: Candidate Identification and Exact Verification
hints.text: A majority candidate must occur frequently enough across random samples or segment tree subranges.

hints.title: Boyer-Moore Segment Tree with Frequency Verification
hints.text: Build a segment tree maintaining Boyer-Moore majority candidates. Verify candidates by binary searching indices in a hash map.

hints.title: Segment Tree Query Blueprint
hints.text: Query segment tree for range candidate. Count exact occurrences in [left, right] using bisect_right minus bisect_left on candidate index list.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Segment tree query takes logarithmic time and binary search on occurrence list takes logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning and hash map counting takes O(N) per query, which exceeds the time limit across thousands of queries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Segment tree pairs Boyer-Moore voting with inverted index lists for constant candidate verification.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Segment tree with Boyer-Moore merge logic or randomized sampling with binary search verification.
